title: How Much Does a Loyalty Program Cost? (2026)

facts.fact: Loop's own page states that its full destination platform starts from $5,000 per year, with the pricing details on its pricing page.
facts.quote: Loop lists the [full destination platform from $5,000 per year](https://loop.fans/pricing).

facts.fact: Loop's standalone AI Trip Planner has separate pricing and is included in the full destination platform, according to the page.
facts.quote: Its standalone AI Trip Planner has separate pricing and is included in the full destination platform.

facts.fact: The page's illustrative single-café model assumes 300 active members, 30 free-drink redemptions a month at a $2 marginal cost each, and two hours of staff administration a month at $25 an hour.
facts.quote: Suppose a café estimates 300 active members.

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative café example, the estimated monthly program cost is $150, made up of $60 for rewards, $50 for staff time and $40 for tools.
facts.quote: The estimated monthly cost is $150: $60 for rewards, $50 for staff time and $40 for tools.

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative café example, each reward costs $2 in marginal fulfilment cost, based on an assumed 30 redemptions per month.
facts.quote: 30 redemptions a month at a $2 marginal cost each

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative café example, the owner's staff administration is priced at $25 an hour for two hours of work.
facts.quote: two hours of staff administration at $25 an hour

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative café example, 20 additional visits at an assumed $6 gross margin each contribute $120, which the page says leaves the program below break-even against the $150 monthly cost.
facts.quote: If each additional visit contributes $6 of gross margin, 20 visits contribute $120, leaving the program below break-even on that narrow measure.

facts.fact: The page defines total monthly program cost as software plus reward cost plus communications plus integrations/equipment plus staff time plus other fees.
facts.quote: **Total monthly cost** = software + reward cost + communications + integrations/equipment + staff time + other fees.
